meeting.title: Function Health security review — working session
meeting.summary: Working session to unstick the Function Health security review (health-data infosec). Agreed the questionnaire handoff, the pen test evidence, and the service account provisioning sequence.
action_items: Ines to return completed SIG Lite questionnaire by June 5
Freya to upload pen test summary to the portal by June 8
Oliver to provision read-only Snowflake service account by June 10
key_decisions: Service account provisioning proceeds immediately after security sign-off, no separate change board review
meeting.notes: The health-data security review has been the blocking chain for three weeks; this session set concrete dates on each link.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Thanks for making time, both. The goal today is to get the security review moving again — it's been the blocker for three weeks.

transcript.speaker: Freya Dunn
transcript.text: Honest answer from our side: the review is stuck because we're missing two inputs — your completed SIG Lite questionnaire and evidence from a recent penetration test. Handling patient lab results, our infosec team can't wave either through.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: The questionnaire is ninety percent done, our security lead has the last section. I'll send the completed SIG Lite questionnaire back to Freya by June 5th.

transcript.speaker: Freya Dunn
transcript.text: Friday works. If I have it Friday, I can start the internal review the following week.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: And the pen test — we have the Q1 report from our external testers. Do you need the full report or a summary?

transcript.speaker: Freya Dunn
transcript.text: A summary with scope and findings severity is enough. Actually, easier if it lives with the rest of the evidence — I'll get the pen test summary uploaded to your portal by Monday, June 8th, once Sam shares it.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: I'll email it to you right after this call, it's ready to go.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Hartley
transcript.text: Then the last link in the chain is me. The warehouse team won't create the service account until security signs off — and with PHI in the schema they're strict about it.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Can we pre-agree the shape so it's a same-day job once you get the green light?

transcript.speaker: Oliver Hartley
transcript.text: Yes — read-only, scoped to the ANALYTICS schema, key-pair auth. I'll provision the read-only Snowflake service account as soon as security signs off — targeting Wednesday, June 10th.

transcript.speaker: Freya Dunn
transcript.text: That's realistic if the questionnaire lands Friday.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitfield
transcript.text: Do we need your change advisory board for the account creation? That added two weeks last time at another customer.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Hartley
transcript.text: No — we agreed internally last month that read-only analytics accounts skip the change board. It goes straight through.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Excellent. So: questionnaire Friday the 5th, pen test summary Monday the 8th, service account Wednesday the 10th. That's the chain unblocked.

transcript.speaker: Freya Dunn
transcript.text: Agreed. Nice to have dates on it at last.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Thanks all — I'll recap in the portal after this.
